Keep the project's components in the working copy .voidhash/, build each with the local Rust
toolchain and rebuild it on every change, and serve the builds on 127.0.0.1.

While it runs, a dev session tells the paywall editor of the signed-in person where the builds are,
so an editor of this project that you have open shows them on its own. Every 15 seconds newer
catalog versions are merged into the working copy. Press Ctrl+C to stop; that ends the session.

Run it in your project's root, where voidhash.json is. Building needs Rust with the
wasm32-unknown-unknown target (https://rustup.rs, then 'rustup target add wasm32-unknown-unknown').

Usage:
  voidhash dev [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help         Show help for this command
      --port <port>  Port on 127.0.0.1

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Examples:
  voidhash dev
  voidhash dev --port 4400
